fr_html:
M. HAGERUP propose un renvoi aux articles 33 et 34. Cette proposition est adoptée.

L'article est approuvé sans autre modification.
en_html: M. HAGERUP proposed that a reference be made to Articles 33 and 34. This was adopted. The Article was approved without further alteration.
